verses.gurmukhi: ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤੁ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rachanaa charitr chit bisam bachitr pan ghaT ghaT ek hee anek hui dhikhaae hai ||

en.bdb: Creation of the wonderful play of the creator's creation is amazing and astonishing. He alone resides in all in several shapes and forms.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤ ਤੇ ਲਿਖਤ ਇਤ ਪਢਤ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਇਤ ਹੰੂ ਤੇ ਲਿਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਤਰ ਪਠਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aut te likhat it paddat a(n)taragat it ha(n)oo te likh prat utar paThaae hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a letter is written by somebody who sends it to someone in another city, it is read there and after understanding it sends back a reply.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤ ਤੇ ਸਬਦ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਕੈ ਉਤ ਸਮਝਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aut te sabadh raag naadh ko prasa(n)n kar it sun samajh kai ut samajhaae hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a singer sings a song in a mode and tune that pleases someone who understands it and educate others about it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਖਿਯਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੫॥
verses.translit_en: ratan pareekhiyaa pekh paramit kai sunaavai gurmukh sa(n)dh mile alakh lakhaae hai ||275||

en.bdb: Just as a jewel evaluator inspects a jewel, learns about its characteristics and educate others about it, so would a Guru oriented Sikh who has become one with True Guru by virtue of His teachings and words, he alone can brief and educate others about the imperceptible Lord. (275)
